response.overview: Based on the Tony-nominated play by George Bernard Shaw, MAJOR BARBARA tells the story of a wildly idealistic young woman, Barbara Undershaft (Sara Haider), who helps the poor as a Salvation Army Major at an anything-goes homeless shelter. She's a stalwart devotee to the cause and has visions for the place - although her ambitions are often squashed by a lack of funding.
response.tagline: A sly comedy of too little and too much.
response.title: George Bernard Shaw's Major Barbara
